name: DeepSeek
handler: return (res) => { const msg = res && res.choices && res.choices[0] && res.choices[0].message; let c = msg && typeof msg.content === "string" ? msg.content : ""; c = c.replace(/```[a-zA-Z]*\n?([\s\S]*?)```/g, "$1").replace(/`{3,}/g, "").replace(/\r/g, "").trim(); c = c.replace(/^(最终答案|答案|answer|选项)\s*[:：]\s*/i, "").trim(); const lines = c.split(/\n+/).map((s) => s.trim()).filter(Boolean); let first = lines.find((l) => l.includes("===")) || lines[0] || ""; first = first.replace(/^`+|`+$/g, "").trim(); first = first.replace(/^[（(【\[]|[）)】\]]$/g, "").trim(); if (/^[A-Za-z](?:\s*[、,，;；|/\s]\s*[A-Za-z])+$/.test(first)) { first = first.replace(/[^A-Za-z]/g, "").toUpperCase(); } else if (/^[A-Za-z]{1,10}$/.test(first)) { first = first.toUpperCase(); } return ["", first]; }
